name: Crumbling Floor
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
description: Around the edges of the pit, more rotting boards are ready to give way.
disable: DC 14 Crafting check to reinforce the beams
reset: As the damage to the floor spreads, the areas adjacent to the new pit become new areas of this hazard.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pitfall
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks next to the pit.

Effect The triggering creature falls in and takes falling damage (typically 3 bludgeoning damage) plus 2d6 piercing damage from landing on broken boards.

That creature can attempt to Grab an Edge to avoid falling; the DC to Climb the walls or Grab an Edge is 14.
